# Bazuki Perfumes

> AI-personalized luxury fragrances and 360° aroma solutions, made-to-order in India. Take a 2-minute quiz to discover three custom scents matched to your personality, mood, and lifestyle.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Brand overview, hero, signature collection highlights, and FAQ.
- [AI Fragrance Quiz](/shop/quiz): 16-question quiz that generates three personalized fragrances.
- [Collection](/collection): Browse signature pre-made scents and community-published custom fragrances.
- [Ingredients](/ingredients): IFRA-compliant fragrance notes used in our formulations.
- [Business / 360° Aroma](/business): Custom aroma marketing solutions for hotels, retail, and offices.
- [About](/about): Our science, technology, and approach to AI fragrance composition.
- [Account](/shop/account): User account for saved scents and order history.
